summary: Operator site (rates, amenities, 2026 map, rules, reservations, history) + Google Maps + imagery read. 30 RV sites (19 FHU, 11 W/E), 30/50A; restrooms/showers, wifi, no dump station; year-round; phone reservations; $50/$55 2026 (price gate: $50 base passes); Google 4.2/141. Five long-stay tests pass. Waterfront: recommend not waterfront -> coastal walk.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes at the line - cheapest RV site (water/electric) $50.00 a night before tax (2026); full hookup $55. A 3% credit-card fee applies.
GOOGLE: 4.2 stars / 141 reviews (gm.py, 2026-11-27). RV Life 4/$$ stored.

LONG-STAY TESTS (all pass): (1) price $50; (2) nightly rate on its own site + phone, no application; (3) only a 2-night holiday minimum; (4) all 30 RV spaces rent by the night (no count of long-term occupants given); (5) RV spaces 27-58 (30) outnumber the mobile-home section (spaces 1-26 by the numbering; two 'Mobile Homes' areas on the map, 'permanent tenants' on the history page). Not mostly seasonal on the evidence, so no caveat line beyond naming the mobile-home section.

WATERFRONT (recommend upgrade, not applied): not waterfront -> 'coastal walk'. Stored evidence ('the Noyo River mouth is ~200 m north beyond buildings and the highway') does not match imagery: the park is WEST of Hwy 1 on the open bluff above the Noyo Harbor entrance and the ocean, northern RV row (spaces 27-30, sold nightly) ~30-60 m from the bluff edge with only bluff grass and the Pomo Bluffs path between, no highway or town. The bluff is high, so no on-water value; the operator says 'All 30 spaces have an ocean view'. Coastal walk (ocean shore on foot via the bluff path, a rocky shore like Seawall/Blackwoods) fits; bayview is the floor. Northern row near 39.4262,-123.8090.
HOOKUPS: electric 50 written (guest map '30/50 amp' sections; some rows 30A only).
PHONE 707-961-1512 and WEBSITE confirmed. STATUS open (year-round).
GOOD SAM: not stated on the operator site (nothing written).
